name: Panoramahotel Garni
beschreibung: The Panoramahotel Garni is situated in a quiet, elevated location on the outskirts of St. Johann in Tirol and offers extensive views of the Kaisergebirge. The surrounding area is characterized by hiking and cycling trails as well as the ski areas of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The house has a wellness area with sauna and steam bath as well as a garden with a lawn for sunbathing. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a bathroom, balcony and free Wi-Fi. As a Garni hotel, the culinary offering is limited to a breakfast buffet; for dinner, dining establishments in the town are available. The atmosphere is informal and caters to couples and active holidaymakers looking for accommodation with breakfast.
